description: Update an app's configuration. Pass only the fields you want to change. Use addDomain/removeDomain to mutate the allowed-origins list atomically without overwriting other entries. `sandbox: true` lets the app load on localhost / non-https origins for development. `ai` is the AI proxy config for the SDK's neblla.ai() — set { model, maxOutputTokens, userTokenMode, presets, limitsEnabled, tokensPerDay } or null to disable. userTokenMode is one of: 'off' (server uses dev key only), 'browser' (user key, browser-direct), 'server' (user key, server-side with private preset prefixes). presets is a {name: prefix} map of named prompt prefixes invoked via neblla.ai({preset:'name'}). limitsEnabled + tokensPerDay cap how many Claude tokens each end-user can spend per day; only applied when userTokenMode = off. `inbox`: true/false, or { maxPerUser, maxOutboundPerUser } to tune the in-app communications inbox (null = defaults). `serverMode`: "js" | "wasm" | "infra" (infra needs an active Pro subscription). `rooms`: the rooms policy object ({ policy, allowedTypes, defaultType, public, private, … }, as returned in the app). A rooms change that discards saved rooms data answers error "rooms_data_loss" with the warnings — show them to the developer and, if they agree, repeat with `confirmRoomsChange: true`. `p2p` (P2P/TURN settings, e.g. { media: true }), `connections` ("all"|"p2p"|"server"|"none"), `theme` (palette/typography/layout), `permissionJustifications` ({ microphone: "why", … }), `guestTtl` (days a guest account lives), `pattern` (app pattern id). Writing to an app that has an unapplied draft discards that draft (the answer says `draftDiscarded: true`). `community` configures user-published entries (neblla.community, see the comunidad guide section): { mode: "open"|"review"|"closed", whoPublishes: "users"|"moderators", maxPayloadBytes, categories[], contentTypes[], maxEntriesPerUser, rules }. The community feature itself is enabled with `features: { community: true }` (it needs login).

addDomain.description: Append a domain entry (URL or origin) to the allowed list

ai.description: AI proxy config: { model, maxOutputTokens, userTokenMode, presets, limitsEnabled, tokensPerDay } — pass null to disable

community.description: Community config (user-published entries): { mode, whoPublishes, maxPayloadBytes, categories, contentTypes, maxEntriesPerUser, rules }. Merged over the stored config.

confirmRoomsChange.description: Set true to apply a rooms change that discards saved rooms data (only after the developer agreed)

features.description: Feature switches to merge into the app: { multiplayer, communications, purchases, ai, friends, login, anticheat, community } as booleans. Only the keys you pass change.

guestTtl.description: Days a guest (no-login) account is kept

inbox.description: Inbox: true/false, or { maxPerUser, maxOutboundPerUser }; null = defaults

matchmaking.description: No-code matchmaking config: { mode: "nocode"|"custom", rule: "count"|"timer"|"count_then_timer"|"button", minPlayers, maxPlayers (0=unlimited), waitSeconds, allowPresenterStart }. In "nocode" mode this regenerates server/gathering.js from the rules; in "custom" mode you own that file.

p2p.description: P2P / TURN settings, e.g. { media: true }

permissionJustifications.description: Why the app needs each browser permission: { microphone, camera, geolocation, midi }

removeDomain.description: Remove a domain entry exactly matching this string

rooms.description: Rooms policy object (same shape the app returns in `rooms`)

sandbox.description: Allow non-https / localhost loads for development

serverMode.description: Where server/*.js runs: js (a player device), wasm, infra (Neblla servers, Pro only)

name: neblla_update_app
